title: Ñ, LL and CH

summary_es.en: Three sounds that exist only in Spanish letters: ñ, ll and ch.
summary_es.fr: Trois sons propres aux lettres espagnoles : ñ, ll et ch.
summary_es.zh: 三个西班牙语特有的字母发音：ñ、ll、ch。
summary_es.ja: スペイン語特有の3つの音：ñ、ll、ch。

tip_es: “ñ” is /ɲ/, like “ny” in “canyon”: año, mañana. It is not the same as “n”: año (year) is not ano. “ll” is /ʎ/ or /ʝ/ (like English “y” in many regions): calle, lluvia. “ch” is /tʃ/, as in English “church”.

confusions.tip_es: It heard a plain “n”. “ñ” is “ny”: the tongue touches the palate and air goes through the nose.
